chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad from Al-Hasan ibn Ali from Aban from Abu Maryam from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
Regarding the Words of Allah, Mighty and Majestic
And give its due on the day of its harvest

He said: You give the poor person the bale on the day of your harvest. Then when it falls into the threshing floor, then when it falls into the sa' (measure), the tenth and half the tenth (is given as zakat).

key_terms.الصَّاعِ: the sa' (a traditional unit of volume measurement)
key_terms.الضِّغْثَ: the bale (a bundle of harvested stalks)

ai.seo_question: How is the zakat on harvest calculated according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi elucidates the practical application of Quranic agricultural tithes by distinguishing between voluntary charity (sadaqah) given at harvest time and the obligatory tithe (ushr) calculated after measurement. It highlights the Shia scholarly emphasis on precise quantification of produce, specifying the tenth or half-tenth as the mandatory portion once the grain is gathered and stored, thereby linking ritual purity with economic justice.
